top_signals.title: Turkey’s Markets Regulator Tightens Rules for Hedge Funds
top_signals.summary: Turkey’s markets regulator announced new rules limiting hedge funds’ exposure to related parties and capping concentrated investments, in a bid to address concerns about abnormal returns and repeated warnings from global index providers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
